entry.summary:
The Hidden Cost of Vibe Coding: Managing "Knowledge Debt"
"Vibe coding"—and utilizing AI in software development broadly—is still a frontier we are all actively mapping. It is undeniably a double-edged sword. On one side, it offers unprecedented speed; features that once took weeks can now be spun up in an hour. It feels miraculously efficient at first. But this speed is not free. It comes at the cost of adding a thick, seductive layer of abstraction between you and your code. The central challenge for anyone learning to code today isn't just "how can I build this," but "how can I build this, internalize the fundamentals, and avoid accruing a mountain of 'Knowledge Debt' that I'll have to pay back later?"
